scenes.narration: This year, we helped over 170 families buy or sell a home.
More than 70 million dollars. But a closing is more than a transaction.
A portion of every closing goes to Filter of Hope. So far, that's over 1,760 water filters.
Clean water, for families who have never had it before.
That's our mission: Making a Difference. Changing Lives. Leaving a Legacy.
Know someone buying or selling in 2027? Send them our way. Evelo Team, 3-1-7, 8-6-3, 9-0-1-1.
